# Mapulus

Mapulus is a platform that enables users to create, manage, and analyze interactive maps, integrating with various applications to automate tasks and leverage location insights.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/mapulus/.

## Actions

- **Get Map Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a map.
- **List Locations** (read-only): List all locations.
- **List Maps** (read-only): List all maps accessible to the user.
- **Find Location by External ID** (read-only): Retrieve locations by external id.
